description.value: MeeT on Main is a fully plant-based comfort food restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, founded in 2014 by three longtime Vancouver hospitality veterans with a mission to bring mainstream diners to plant-based eating. The menu leans into familiar comfort staples — poutine, burgers, 'chikkin' skewers, mac and cheese — all made from scratch with house-made sauces and no animal products. A patio, full craft cocktail program, and brunch service round out what is a lively neighbourhood anchor on a busy cycling corridor.
